question: Which of the following is NOT a result of the ozone layer depletion?

options.text: The Earth getting more UV rays from the Sun

solution:
The correct answer is __'**Tsunami'**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The amount of **UVB** that reaches the Earth's surface rises as a result of **ozone layer loss.**
 
• The **breakdown of ozone** in the stratosphere, where it protects the earth from damaging ultraviolet radiation, is known as **ozone depletion**.
 
• Chemical processes that utilize hydrogen, nitrogen, chlorine, and bromine oxides as **catalysts** lead to its demise.
 
• Humans are** exposed to dangerous UV radiation** as a result of ozone layer loss, which can lead to skin conditions, cataracts, cancer, weakened immune systems, etc.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• By a combination of ground-based and satellite data in the **early 1980s**, researchers came to the conclusion that Earth's natural sunscreen was significantly diminishing over the South Pole each spring.
 
• The **thick layer of ozone** that is present in the **stratosphere**, 15 to 30 kilometres above the surface of the earth, is referred to as the "ozone layer" in this context.
 
• By absorbing the sun's harmful ultraviolet-B **(UV-B) radiation**, which permeates the entire planet, it protects life on earth.
